_Proxy: Enable when behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy so rate limiting and the security audit see the real client IP (X-Forwarded-For) and scheme. List the proxy IPs you trust.
_Auth: Set Auth:Require=true (or env Auth__Require=true) in production to require sign-in for every endpoint via the security module. Off by default so local dev and the E2E suite run without credentials (a fully-privileged guest admin). On first run with a BootstrapAdmin set, that account is created; set its password via user-secrets/env (Auth__BootstrapAdmin__Password), not this file.

Auth._Email: SMTP for self-service email (password reset, verification). Leave Host empty to disable self-service email (admin can still create + reset users directly). Set Password out-of-band (Auth__Email__Password).

Local._Mfa: Require = None (opt-in) | Administrators | All. Users covered by the policy must enrol a TOTP authenticator before using the app.

Providers._Oidc: Optional OpenID Connect providers (Entra/Google/Okta/generic). Enable one below and set its ClientSecret out-of-band (Auth__Providers__Oidc__0__ClientSecret). RoleClaimType + GroupRoleMap map IdP groups/roles to app roles at sign-in; AutoProvision creates a local account on first login with DefaultRole.
